# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 2: Maritime Warfare, Letters of Marque, Strait Toll CBs & 5 Historical Expeditions (oe_nav2_). Generated by gen_v125_maritime.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Pick the best ocean-accessible port into scope:departure_loc (fallback: capital).
oe_nav2_pick_ocean_departure_port = {
	ordered_owned_non_rural_location = {
		limit = { oe_nav2_is_ocean_port = yes }
		order_by = development
		max = 1
		save_scope_as = departure_loc
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:departure_loc } }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_nav2_is_ocean_port = yes }
			order_by = development
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = departure_loc
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:departure_loc } }
		capital ?= { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
}

# Country scope. Pick the best African overland hub for the Western Sahara Gold & Sankore Caravan.
oe_nav2_pick_sahara_departure = {
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:fez }
		location:fez = { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:marrakesh }
		location:marrakesh = { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:tunis }
		location:tunis = { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:cairo }
		location:cairo = { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
	else = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_nav2_is_sahara_caravan_origin = yes }
			order_by = development
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = departure_loc
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:departure_loc } }
		capital ?= { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
}

# Country scope. Pick the best Eurasian mainland hub for the Silk Road Overland Diplomatic Mission.
oe_nav2_pick_silk_departure = {
	if = {
		limit = { capital ?= { oe_nav2_is_mainland_eurasia_location = yes } }
		capital = { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
	else = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_nav2_is_mainland_eurasia_location = yes }
			order_by = development
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = departure_loc
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:departure_loc } }
		capital ?= { save_scope_as = departure_loc }
	}
}

# Country scope. Grant Silk Road goodwill to the sovereign holding a named terminus location (has_owner guarded).
oe_nav2_grant_location_owner_goodwill = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_nav2_envoy_sender
	$LOC$ = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_nav2_envoy_sender }
					country_exists = this
					is_rebel_country = no
				}
			}
			owner = {
				add_opinion = {
					target = scope:oe_nav2_envoy_sender
					modifier = oe_nav2_b_maritime_goodwill
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75 helper: stage privateer conflict & grant preview of all 3 maritime CBs.
oe_nav2_dev_marque_cb = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_nav2_dev_actor
	add_gold = 300
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active
		years = 5
		mode = replace
	}
	ordered_known_country = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
			NOT = { this = scope:oe_nav2_dev_actor }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_nav2_dev_actor }
		}
		order_by = navy_size
		max = 1
		save_scope_as = oe_nav2_dev_rival
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_nav2_dev_rival }
		add_casus_belli = {
			target = scope:oe_nav2_dev_rival
			type = casus_belli:oe_nav2_cb_strait_toll_dispute
			years = 5
		}
		add_casus_belli = {
			target = scope:oe_nav2_dev_rival
			type = casus_belli:oe_nav2_cb_suppress_piracy
			years = 5
		}
		add_casus_belli = {
			target = scope:oe_nav2_dev_rival
			type = casus_belli:oe_nav2_cb_protect_coreligionists
			years = 5
		}
		scope:oe_nav2_dev_rival = {
			save_scope_as = oe_nav2_marque_issuer
			set_variable = {
				name = oe_nav2_factory_dispute_against
				value = scope:oe_nav2_dev_actor
				years = 5
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_nav2_marque_harassed
				years = 5
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		save_scope_as = oe_nav2_marque_victim
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nav2.1
	}
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75 helper: fund treasury, clear W2 expedition cooldowns, and ensure an eligible leader.
oe_nav2_dev_exp_prep = {
	add_gold = 1500
	if = {
		limit = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_arctic_cd }
		remove_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_arctic_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_treasure_cd }
		remove_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_treasure_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_sahara_cd }
		remove_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_sahara_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_silk_cd }
		remove_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_silk_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_enlight_cd }
		remove_cooldown = oe_nav2_exp_enlight_cd
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_expedition_leader = no
					has_exploration = no
				}
			}
		}
		create_character = {
			age = 32
			adm = 68
			dip = 74
			mil = 66
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
		}
	}
}
